title: Passkeys and recovery
item.name: Passkey {n}
item.never-used: Not used for a sign-in yet
item.no-prf: Cannot unlock your encryption keys (no PRF)
last: Your only passkey cannot be removed.
remove.title: Remove this passkey?
remove.body: You can no longer sign in with this passkey. Your other passkeys keep working.
remove.body-current: This passkey signed in this browser. Removing it ends this session and you sign in again with another passkey.
add.title: Add passkey
add.explain: A second passkey keeps your account reachable if you lose a device. Use one that supports unlocking your keys (PRF).
add.other-device: Add passkey on another device (QR code or security key)
add.confirm.explain: The passkey was created. Confirm once with the new passkey so that it can unlock your encryption keys.
add.cancelled: The passkey ceremony was cancelled – try again.
add.exists: This authenticator already holds a passkey of your account. Use another one.
add.other: Another passkey answered. Confirm with the passkey you just created.
add.done: The passkey was added. It signs in and unlocks your keys.
add.done-no-prf: The passkey was added. It signs you in, but cannot unlock your keys (no PRF): unlocking then needs your recovery code or a remembered browser.
browser.title: This browser
browser.remembered: This browser can unlock without passkey PRF (since {time}).
browser.none: This browser cannot unlock without a passkey that supports PRF.
browser.failed: This browser cannot store a device key.
recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.unconfirmed: Recovery code not confirmed. Type your code below to confirm that you have it.
recovery.explain: Check your recovery code: it is compared with your encrypted recovery copy in this browser and stays valid.
recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.wrong: This is not your recovery code.
recovery.rotation: A recovery with the code, or “Generate a new recovery code” below, issues a new code that replaces the old one.
recovery-new.title: New recovery code
recovery-new.explain: Lost your recovery code, or think someone else saw it? Generate a new one. The old code stops working as soon as the new one is saved.
recovery-new.confirm-first: Write down the new code and confirm it. It is saved only after you confirm it with your passkey; until then the old code stays valid.
recovery-new.done: Your new recovery code is saved. The old code no longer works.
recovery-new.cancelled: The passkey confirmation was cancelled. Nothing changed; try again.
prf-missing.explain: This passkey cannot unlock your encryption keys on this device.
prf-missing.options: You are signed in. To unlock your keys, choose one of these options:
prf-missing.recovery.title: Unlock with your recovery code
prf-missing.recovery.label: Recovery code
prf-missing.recovery.hint: This unlocks your keys this time. The code stays valid.
prf-missing.remember.hint: A key that never leaves this browser encrypts your identity here, so the next sign-in on this browser needs no recovery code. Do not use this on shared devices.
prf-missing.other.title: Use a passkey from another device
prf-missing.other: On a device where you are signed in, open Settings → Passkeys and recovery → Add passkey, and add a passkey that supports unlocking (PRF).
prf-missing.offer.title: Remember this browser?
prf-missing.offer.body: Without it, every sign-in on this browser needs your recovery code. A key that never leaves this browser can encrypt your identity here instead. Do not use this on shared devices.
prf-missing.offer.failed: This browser cannot store a device key. Continue without it.
